title: Hark the Glad Sound
description: Hark the Glad Sound in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 7 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Philip Doddridge, first published in 1735. The tune, CHESTERFIELD, is by Thomas Haweis (1792). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Hark, the glad sound! the Sa_-vior comes! The Sa_-vior pro_-mised long; Let ev_-ery heart_ pre-pare_ a throne, And ev_-ery voice_ a song.

lines: Hark, the glad sound! the Savior comes!
Let every heart prepare a throne,
On Him the Spirit, largely poured,
Wisdom and might, and zeal and love,
He comes the pris'ners to release,
The gates of brass before Him burst,
He comes from thickest films of vice
And on the eyeballs of the blind
He comes the broken heart to bind,
And with the treasures of His grace
Our debts are all remitted now
Our glad hosannas, Prince of Peace,
